arrangement.notes: Arrangement focuses on vocal presence enhanced by modern sample chopping techniques. Energy profile is club-oriented with a dark mood emphasizing introspective vocal lines and atmospheric textures.

event_markers.label: Atmospheric Shift
event_markers.reason: Transition with dark FX textures and sample chops

event_markers.label: Sample Chop Setup
event_markers.reason: Introduce modern sample chopping drum techniques

sample_chopping.description: Modern sample chopping applied to vocal and drum layers

vocal.focus: sharp, dark, and intimate vocal samples with chopping variations

drums.style: trip-hop groove with chopped, glitchy drum hits

track_roles.drums: Percussive backbone with chopped glitch elements
track_roles.chords: Dark atmospheric pads and harmonic textures
track_roles.melody: Pitch-shifted sample chops to complement vocal
track_roles.vocal: Lead vocal samples with modern chopping techniques
track_roles.fx: Transition and atmospheric effects from chopped samples

designer_intent.goal: Create a dark, vocal-focused trip hop arrangement with club energy by leveraging modern sample chopping techniques across multiple channels.

presetor_intent.goal: Implement preset chains emphasizing sample chops in vocal and drum channels with appropriate effects to enhance dark atmosphere.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate glitchy and chopped drum patterns emphasizing trip hop groove with attention to tight transient shaping.

bass_generator.brief: Create a sub-bass line complementing the dark club energy without overpowering vocals.

harmony_generator.brief: Design atmospheric pads using dark chords that support the vocal mood and arrangement.

melody_generator.brief: Produce supporting melodic layers from pitch-shifted chopped samples fitting a dark trip hop style.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement structure to balance energy flow, emphasizing vocal focus and sample chopping technique variety.

presetor.brief: Apply effect presets enhancing chopped sample clarity and space, ensuring a cohesive dark club vibe.

songgps.brief: Manage arrangement sections, energy curve, and event markers ensuring clear progression aligned with design intent.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Mix unprocessed channel audio prioritizing vocal clarity and consistent dark atmospheric blend.
